input: What lease lengths do you offer?
reference: Standard lease terms are 24, 36 or 48 months.

input: How many miles can I drive and what happens if I go over?
reference: 12,000 miles per year are included; extra miles cost $0.20 each at the end of the lease.

input: Can I end my lease after 8 months?
reference: Ending before month 12 needs approval from a credit manager. After 12 months the fee is three monthly payments plus any past-due amounts.
Yes: comprehensive and collision for the full term, with the lessor listed as additional insured.

input: What can I do when my lease ends?
reference: Return the vehicle, buy it at the residual value in the contract, or roll into a new lease.

input: My credit score is 710 and my debt-to-income is 35%. Will I be approved?
reference: Score 700+ with DTI under 40% is approved automatically, so yes, subject to documents.

input: Which documents do I need to apply?
reference: Proof of income, a government-issued ID and proof of address from the last 90 days.

input: Can you help me pick stocks to invest in?
reference: Politely decline: only lease and application questions are in scope.
